## Online Web Tools & Calculators Portfolio
evonix provides 100% client-side, zero-database online utilities engineered for international exporters, e-commerce brands, developers, and hardware technicians. All calculations occur locally in browser memory without remote server data retention.

### Flagship 5 Mobile & Cloud Tools:
1. Global Micro-Invoice Generator: https://www.evonixtec.com/invoice
   - Multi-currency electronic commercial and tax invoice maker
   - Automatic Code128 barcodes, GST/VAT for 100+ countries, A4 PDF download
   - Zero database: line items, shipping details, and tax breakdowns stay private

2. B2B Industrial CBM & Freight Engine: https://www.evonixtec.com/cbm-calculator
   - Cargo Cubic Meters (CBM) volume calculator and air volumetric weight engine
   - Calculates 20ft (33 CBM), 40ft (67.7 CBM), and 40ft High Cube (76.4 CBM) container stuffing limits
   - Air courier divisor (/ 5000) vs Air cargo divisor (/ 6000) comparison

3. E-Commerce Margin & COD Simulator: https://www.evonixtec.com/ecommerce-calculator
   - Unit economics, courier COD tariffs (TCS, Leopards, Trax, PostEx), and RTO return loss simulator
   - Breakeven ROAS and target Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) solver

4. Dedicated Developer Cost Calculator: https://www.evonixtec.com/developer-cost-calculator
   - International developer hourly rate comparison (USA/UK/Dubai vs Sialkot offshore rates)
   - Senior developer benchmark ($22/hr offshore vs $80/hr USA, saving 72% annually)

5. Website AI Visibility & GEO E-E-A-T Auditor: https://www.evonixtec.com/ai-visibility-checker
   - Audit web domain readiness for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Claude, and Perplexity
   - Brand entity node connectivity, TLS security verification, and structured JSON-LD schema analysis

### Additional Engineering Lab Bench Tools:
6. Export Barcode Label Studio: https://www.evonixtec.com/export-barcode-studio
   - GS1-128 and Code 128 thermal 4"x6" outer carton shipping labels for surgical, sports & leather goods
7. Live RMA Bench Repair Tracker: https://www.evonixtec.com/live-repair-tracker
   - Real-time diagnostic bench ticket lookup, standby current measurements, technician logs
8. Thermal Receipt Printer Diagnostic Engine: https://www.evonixtec.com/printer-diagnostics
   - ESC/POS 80mm thermal receipt printer troubleshooter, cutter lockups, baud rate mismatches
9. Factory ERP & Customs Network Latency Benchmark: https://www.evonixtec.com/factory-network-tester
   - Dual-WAN ping jitter benchmark, WeBOC customs gateway ping stability
